objective: Exceed annual new policy sales target and reduce cost per new policy sale
targeting: MultiCar, EV, telematics and brand-trust growth personas

planning_priorities.label: 1 March and 1 September plate-change peaks
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: Maximise sales impact of the March and September plate-change campaigns; plan activations early and focus on efficiency, attention and incremental new policy sales.

planning_priorities.label: World Cup summer context
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: No incremental tentpole budget for the World Cup; combine June/July budgets with contextual, fixture-aware TV and CTV creative rather than blanket inflation.

planning_priorities.label: 'Always Looking Out For You' creative platform
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: Support the brand-trust platform launch without a fundamental media strategy change; maintain phasing towards proven campaign tactics while building consideration and trust.

planning_priorities.label: MultiCar household growth opportunity
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: Demonstrate a combined strategic comms and media approach for incremental MultiCar household growth within the existing budget.

planning_priorities.label: EV growth opportunity
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: Support Admiral's publicly stated EV strength around switching and plate-change moments; incremental budget considered above the base media budget where the case is strong.

planning_priorities.label: PCW conversion defence
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: No broad above-the-line promotional push planned for 2026, but paid search and journey investment can be used tactically to defend quote-to-policy conversion if aggregator CPC rises.

planning_priorities.label: Channel role clarity
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: Provide clarity on OOH, audio, CTV, Paid Search, Paid Social, Display and partnerships/content roles.

planning_priorities.label: Commercial opportunity strategy
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: Review media savings/value beyond guarantees and consider direct media-owner deal opportunities.

planning_priorities.label: 2026 testing framework
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: Agree a testing framework based on MultiCar, EV and telematics growth opportunities in collaboration with media investment and insight teams.
